The official organisation

Defence Garden

Defence Garden develops premium plotted residential townships across Shamli, Meerut and Budhana in Western Uttar Pradesh. Its public project information covers developments in Shamli, Meerut and Budhana.

For project enquiries, plot availability or site visits, contact the Defence Garden team directly.
